Maintain current operation as required by the planned NORMAL mode; no parameter changes are permitted.
Add a +10.75°C sensor offset for zone 3 so the controller sees the temperature at its 45 °C setpoint, eliminating the regulation error while staying in the planned NORMAL mode.
All heaters off to guarantee safety as zone 3 cannot meet setpoint within regulation band.
